title: Session list factory produces time-dependent fixtures
reasoning: createMockSessionList derives each session date from Date.now(), so the same test receives different fixture dates depending on the day it runs. That makes assertions around ordering, filtering, snapshots, and date boundaries nondeterministic, especially near timezone or midnight boundaries.
reproduction: Run a test that asserts createMockSessionList()[0].session.date equals a fixed expected date on two different calendar days; the result changes because it is based on the current clock.
recommendation: Use a fixed base date in the factory, or accept an explicit baseDate override while defaulting to a stable value.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No included tests pin factory output or verify deterministic fixture generation.
suggestedRegressionTest: Assert that two calls to createMockSessionList with default arguments return the same dates regardless of the current mocked system time.
minimumFixScope: Change app/__tests__/factories/mockSessionFactory.ts so createMockSessionList uses a stable base date instead of Date.now().
